test_title: PYST 45: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate verb form to fill in the blank.

Arun _______ his bicycle to school every day.
solution:
The correct answer is **rides**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**rides**" is the simple present tense form of the verb "**ride**" for the third person singular subject "Arun."
 
• The sentence describes a habitual action ("every day"), so the simple present tense "**rides**" is required.
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and 4 are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"Arun **rides**__ his bicycle to school every day."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "ride"** is incorrect because it does not agree with the third person singular subject "Arun."
 
• **Option 2: "riding"** is incorrect because it is the present participle form, which does not fit here.
 
• **Option 4: "rode"** is incorrect because it is the simple past tense form, whereas the sentence requires the present tense.
